routes.title: Annupuri Slopes & Soba
routes.summary: Start your day with exhilarating activities on the Niseko Annupuri slopes. Conclude with a warm, authentic soba lunch at Rakuichi, offering a taste of local craft.

routes.title: Annupuri: Ski & Curry Escape
routes.summary: Enjoy a relaxed morning on the Niseko Annupuri slopes. Pause mid-mountain for a hearty Japanese curry or ramen lunch at Boyo-so Lodge, taking in the serene mountain atmosphere.

routes.title: Annupuri Slopes & Soba Refuel
routes.summary: Begin the day with activity on Niseko Annupuri's slopes. Enjoy a renowned soba lunch, then conclude with a casual Japanese curry or ramen at a mid-mountain lodge.

routes.title: Hirafu Onsen to Backcountry Powder
routes.summary: Enjoy a morning soak in Hirafu's hot springs. A light lunch at a cozy cafe precedes an exhilarating afternoon exploring Niseko's untouched backcountry terrain with a guide.

routes.title: Niseko Powder to Hirafu Izakaya
routes.summary: Start with guided backcountry skiing, then warm up with a hearty izakaya lunch in Hirafu. Spend the afternoon exploring the groomed slopes and powder stashes of Niseko Grand Hirafu.

routes.title: Niseko Powder & Onsen Day
routes.summary: Begin with a rejuvenating onsen soak in Hirafu before a casual cafe lunch. Spend the afternoon exploring Niseko's backcountry powder with a guide, then refuel with izakaya fare. Cap off the day with resort skiing at Grand Hirafu.

routes.title: Hirafu Powder & Culinary Heights
routes.summary: Start with guided backcountry thrills, refuel at a lively izakaya, then hit Grand Hirafu's slopes. Cap the day with exquisite modern French-Japanese dining, followed by a late-night ski school session in Hirafu.

routes.title: Niseko: Powder, Onsen & Hirafu Eats
routes.summary: Begin your packed Niseko day with an onsen soak, then chase deep powder on a guided backcountry tour. Refuel with lunch before hitting Grand Hirafu's slopes, ending with a lively izakaya dinner and exploring ski school options in Hirafu.

routes.title: Hirafu: Powder, French & Onsen Dip
routes.summary: Start with a thrilling morning of guided backcountry and resort skiing, followed by casual izakaya for lunch. The evening brings upscale French-Japanese dining before unwinding in a soothing onsen.

routes.title: Hanazono Snow & Kaiseki Night
routes.summary: Experience an evening of Niseko snow thrills starting with tubing at Hanazono. Indulge in a luxurious kaiseki steak dinner before an exhilarating snowmobile tour caps off the night.

routes.title: Hanazono Snow Thrills and Kaiseki Delights
routes.summary: Begin your day with exhilarating snowmobiling in Hanazono, followed by a luxurious kaiseki or steak lunch at An Dining. Conclude with ski or snowboard lessons to hone your skills on the slopes.

routes.title: Hanazono Winter Thrills & Culinary Delight
routes.summary: Begin with the exhilaration of Hanazono night tubing, then savor a luxurious kaiseki and steak dinner. The day continues with a thrilling snowmobile tour, concluding with ski or snowboard instruction.

routes.title: Niseko Hanazono Winter Adventure
routes.summary: Begin the day with an exhilarating snowmobile tour through Hanazono's snowy landscapes. Recharge with a luxurious kaiseki and steak lunch at An Dining, then hit the slopes for ski or snowboard lessons at the renowned Hanazono Resort.

routes.title: Hanazono Winter Thrills
routes.summary: Start with evening snow thrills like tubing and snowmobiling. Enjoy a kaiseki or steak dinner, then hit the slopes for ski lessons at Hanazono Resort.
